# Astronomy

The lunar observatory tracks the Moon with a radio telescope. Its instruments measure craters and reflected sunlight. Astronomers record observations at midnight and calibrate sensors using distant stars. The observatory stores images in an archive for later analysis.

# Botany

The greenhouse grows tomatoes in nutrient rich soil. Gardeners water the roots every morning and monitor humidity with electronic sensors. Tomato plants require sunlight for photosynthesis. The harvest is collected in summer and delivered to the village market.

# Transport

The electric railway connects the harbor to the city center. Trains depart every fifteen minutes during daylight. Passengers purchase tickets at the station. Engineers inspect the brakes each evening and charge the battery overnight at the depot.

# Ocean

The marine laboratory studies coral reefs in tropical waters. Divers photograph fish and collect water samples to measure salinity. Reef ecosystems shelter young animals from predators. Researchers publish monthly reports about ocean temperatures and conservation efforts.
